meta.adjudication_go: Greg S110: 'run with your plan for proposals and fixes for platform' - recorded in DECISIONS.md D18 family; protocol: additive amendments only, incumbents byte-identical, backup + version bump
meta.merge_rule: PROPOSAL + adjudication (D8). Every amendment ADDS a dated key; no pre-existing key is rewritten. Statuses honest (PROPOSED unless spanning-group evidence says PROVISIONAL). Attribution fence: the A11 data repairs changed inputs - no G23 improvement banks as play evidence.

amendments_to_incumbents.value: S109 P3, adjudicated S110: the FRESH arm (+1500..+2500) is WINTER-measured with no summer instance, and G22 supplies an n=1 summer REFUTATION (0629: driver arrived exactly as forecast - CDD +4.7 realized 14.8 vs forecast 14.815 - and the gap paid +50 against a rescaled +350..+800 call; session -1,160). Scope the fresh arm to winter explicitly. No summer band is proposed - n=1 licenses a scope restriction, not a number. Summer weekend gaps emit via boundary.weekend_gap_wide_band_emission.

A4 (E, n=2 spanning): the trigger set gains is_expiry_day on the ROLL-DESTINATION leg - the largest scheduled program in the NG calendar was the play's missing trigger. Instances: G21 0608 (resting/inverted form), G22 0626 (aggressor/saturated form: big prints 0.783 size-weighted on 210 while session_b_share_two_sided sat 0.509->0.504 and the residual tape net-sold). CONSEQUENCE GUARD: on program days big-print instruments (the 0.547 bar, price_free_absorption_proxy, handoff confirm/refute limbs) lose authority - read the RESIDUAL (ex-program) tape. Control: 0625 (opex+EIA, also scheduled-flow) shows none of the fingerprints.

A6 (A, n=2 vs n=2): the REALIZING arm's exemplars are winter SHOT-class (unpriced driver lands). A slope-class crest (priced seasonal ramp visible in the ladder) is out of scope - applying the arm there produced the 0703 blind miss and 0629's gap call. Test: is the driver IN the forward ladder at the exit (priced branch) or absent from it (shot branch)? Shot -> arm applies; slope -> hill grammar applies (a hill slopes, it does not gap).

A7 (A; sqrt(participation) survives its second consecutive forward pass - net 410 vs 453 predicted on 0703): the repair clause's 'deadline-bound participant' now carries a taxonomy: VOLUME-BOUND programs (bcom/gsci roll, bidweek, expiry, opex) preserve RANGE (invariance holds); RISK-BOUND participants (holiday-eve weekend squaring/procurement) tilt SIGN without preserving range. A holiday-eve session can carry a risk-bound participant while all volume-bound flags read false.

new_plays_proposed.trigger: any play stating an ABSOLUTE HDD threshold, evaluated in a block whose realized or forecast regime is CDD-dominant (gw_cdd >> gw_hdd)
new_plays_proposed.read: an unreachable absolute HDD bar returns UNKNOWN - never a satisfied/refuted boolean. It must not default a selector to a direction (divergence_resolution 16.4 unreachable -> silent bearish default) and must not void a band (shoulder_weather_band_void 13.5 trivially satisfied -> weather band voided every summer day).
new_plays_proposed.call: treat the play limb as UNEVALUABLE; fall through to the CDD-side instruments (the ladder + burn gate)
new_plays_proposed.requires: the block's realized or forecast CDD/HDD regime (weather_forecast)
new_plays_proposed.scope: any play with an absolute HDD bar, in CDD regimes; the mirror (CDD bars in HDD regimes) is expected but unmeasured
new_plays_proposed.evidence: S109/G22: four independent HDD-keyed artifacts all degraded bearish-or-void in one CDD block; the blind's four down-calls-that-printed-up contributed -3,840 signed error of a -1,815 drift; B named the mechanism in its 0629 posterior BEFORE scoring
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: NONE yet - forward test = a winter block where the same bars evaluate normally (the play must be INERT outside CDD regimes)
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a winter block where this play fires (it must not - inertness outside CDD regimes is the claim)

new_plays_proposed.trigger: any weekend or holiday seam (a boundary spanning >= 2 model cycles)
new_plays_proposed.read: run-delta channels baseline run-over-run, NOT session-over-session; across a multi-cycle seam the accumulation appears in no single delta and the channel is STRUCTURALLY ~ZERO. Difference the LEVELS (D0 vs the prior session's D0).
new_plays_proposed.call: seam weather reads use LEVEL differences only; run deltas are intra-week instruments
new_plays_proposed.requires: weather_forecast levels on both sides of the seam
new_plays_proposed.scope: all seams; deltas stay valid intra-week
new_plays_proposed.evidence: G22 0629: forecast_run_delta_cdd -0.219 and sunday_reopen d +0.096 against a +4.7 LEVEL add; mechanism verified on 0624 (level +2.205, field -0.011); E's 0626 grammar; B-0629 executed the level rule by hand and derived the sign pre-tape
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: n=2 channels x 2 instances in G22; B r2 adds close-at-the-slope n=3 spanning G21/G22
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: an intra-week day where the run delta and the level difference disagree (they should not - the claim is scoped to seams)

new_plays_proposed.trigger: weekend seam with model_disagreement.stability serving multi-horizon seasonal-axis revision deltas (pre-reopen legit)
new_plays_proposed.read: a COHERENT multi-horizon add/cut on the season's demand axis (all reachable horizons revised the same way) owns the seam's SIGN. Positioning does not sign a seam (1/3); it is a sign-agnostic GAIN term: |gap|/sigma ran 1.2-2.0 at a <=5-pctile worsening book vs 0.08 at a normalized book.
new_plays_proposed.call: seam sign from the stability ladder's coherent revision; gain from positioning extremeness; NEVER a point gap - see boundary.weekend_gap_wide_band_emission
new_plays_proposed.requires: model_disagreement.stability multi-horizon deltas on the seasonal axis; cot pctile + WoW
new_plays_proposed.scope: weekend/holiday seams; measured on CDD-axis summer seams G21-G22
new_plays_proposed.evidence: 3/3 measured seams: 0614 near-window cut -> -750; 0621 coherent add -> +1,210; 0628 largest add -> +50 (sign right, size inverted - see the wide-band play); reopen participation refuted in both directions (252 lots -> +1,210; 194-trade stub -> +50)
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: n=3 in one session's measurement, spanning G21/G22; forward test G23's two seams
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a coherent multi-horizon add followed by a wrong-signed gap
new_plays_proposed.caveats: the channel's own label ('uncertainty conditioner') steered readers away - served-but-MISLABELED; label fix queued (A11.2)

new_plays_proposed.read: the weekend gap is NOT ownable as a POINT from current instruments (confirmed negative, measured twice in opposite directions: 0622 forecast +20 actual +1,210; 0629 forecast +480 actual +50). Add-size does not sort gap-size (inverted across 0621/0628). The SESSION read is a separate, sound instrument (0622 session err 120 while its gap missed by 1,190).
new_plays_proposed.call: emit the gap as SIGN (from weekend.seam_sign_from_stability_ladder) + WIDE BAND: ~0.5-1.0x sigma mid-book, 1.5-2.5x sigma at a <=5-pctile worsening extreme; SCORE GAP AND SESSION SEPARATELY; day-move p50 belongs at the slope-derived level (close-at-the-slope, n=3 G21/G22)
new_plays_proposed.requires: the stability ladder + cot; vol sigma (note n0 era basis)
new_plays_proposed.scope: all weekend/holiday seams until an instrument earns point authority
new_plays_proposed.evidence: B-0622 refine (the P3 question answered mechanically); high-gain seams round-trip intraday n=2 (0615 gave back 121%, 0622 46%)
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: n=2 misses opposite directions + n=3 sign ladder; forward test G23
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a block where a pre-committed POINT gap call lands inside +-300 on both Mondays (would license point emission again)

new_plays_proposed.trigger: any weather-slope directional lean in a CDD regime (and expected mirror in HDD once measured)
new_plays_proposed.read: the slope's TRANSMISSION to gas call runs through the burn residual: gas call = weather load - renewables - absorbable. A CDD add converts only if est_gas_burn_bcfd confirms (flat-to-up) and wind is not ramping against it. WIND IS A DAMPER, NEVER A SORTER (0630 printed up under a rising-wind slice). WEEKDAY-NORMALIZE burn comparisons (Sat/Sun rows collapse mechanically; Sat-over-Sat form survives). grid_stack staleness ~D+2: a Monday reads Saturday - treat as the freshest SAME-DAY-CLASS comparison, never same-day truth.
new_plays_proposed.call: burn-confirmed slope lean = full band; wind-on/burn-down = suppress the up-lean toward the constraint floor (-150..-200 class); the gate reads BOTH WAYS (an up-lean must check wind is not contradicting; a down-lean must check burn is not ramping)
new_plays_proposed.requires: grid_stack (est_gas_burn_bcfd, wind_mwh, solar_mwh) decision-legit; weather_forecast CDD ladder
new_plays_proposed.scope: CDD-regime slope reads; HDD mirror unmeasured; per-BA never pooled as a conclusion (US48 carried as its own row)
new_plays_proposed.evidence: BOTH polarities inside G22: 0629 wind +62%/burn -4.2 suppressed a realized +4.8 CDD add (-1,160); 0624 wind -22%/burn +6.3 delivered (+800); 0630 (+780 into 40.2), 0703 (+410 at 44.8 block-max); 0625/0702 confirming mirrors (D). E's two-limb flip test executed both ways (0629 HOLD DOWN vindicated; 0703 PASS UP delivered)
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: 6 in-block instances, 2 polarities, one block - forward test G23 (attribution fence: the ladder repair changed inputs)
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a burn-confirmed CDD add that fails to deliver, or a wind-on day that delivers gross-CDD anyway, in G23+

new_plays_proposed.read: the pre-print window is REOPEN -> 10:30, not 08:00-10:30 (D's own blind falsifier was drawn too narrow and 'never fired' while the decomposition failed). On gate-fired days the chain's residual delivers OVERNIGHT and the post-print window belongs to the counter side. Catalyst up-size applies to RANGE, not NET, on exhaustion-class prints (0702: 1,380 travel, 0 net).
new_plays_proposed.call: window assignment per above; timing claims falsify against reopen->print mass, not a sub-window
new_plays_proposed.requires: phase/timing off the tape; the print calendar
new_plays_proposed.evidence: 0625: 44.4% of variation pre-10:30, high at 09:00; 0702: overnight -480 delivery, print = stop-run into the absorber (-1.4 BELOW consensus flushed to a marginal low then reclaimed); G17 instances per D's lens record
new_plays_proposed.forward_evidence: n=4 spanning; G20's decomposition lesson (2,090 credited from day nets, timing refuted 1-of-4) is the cautionary sibling
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a print day whose pre-10:30 share is trivial while the gate fired (would restore the narrow window)

new_plays_proposed.trigger: the session after a D-1 up-leg
new_plays_proposed.read: D-1 rally QUALITY sorts next-day magnitude class: an ALIGNED rally (flow with price) -> hold class; a CONVICTION-NEGATIVE pop (rise on net-sell / absorption) -> 50-70% give-back next session. Covering-financed up-legs get full credit to the REVERSAL-RECLAIM and are DENIED post-reclaim extension absent an aligned up phase - resolves the absorption_is_reversal full-size-vs-round-trip tension mechanically.
new_plays_proposed.call: size the next session's counter-leg at 50-70% of a conviction-negative pop; cap covering days at the reclaim line
new_plays_proposed.requires: phase flow-vs-price conviction on D-1 (flow_read fields)
new_plays_proposed.scope: spanning g19 class + G22 (0624->0625 vs 0630->0701; A's r2 used the reclaim-cap on 0703 and the close landed under the line)
new_plays_proposed.evidence: 0630 pop (+790 on -4,266 absorbed) -> 0701 gave back 63%; 0624 aligned break (+790 on aligned phases) -> 0625 held (-60); D-0702's covering grammar; A-r2's two-sided derivation triangulating +450 vs actual +410
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a conviction-negative pop followed by a held extension (no give-back) with no new driver

new_plays_proposed.trigger: any day whose D-1 carried a scheduled program (expiry, bcom/gsci roll, opex)
new_plays_proposed.read: the Monday/next-day gate consumes the PROGRAM-DECONTAMINATED D-1 tilt - never the raw aggregate (0629's +871 aggregate hid a net-selling residual once the roll cohort's >=+4,800 was struck).
new_plays_proposed.call: carry residual_tilt as an explicit handoff field on program days; the receiving specialist reads it in place of session_signed_flow's sign
new_plays_proposed.requires: big-print cohort decomposition of the D-1 tape (flow_read)
new_plays_proposed.evidence: B-0629: the tilt gate fed +871 gross and weighted the self-derived residual 0.10 - the sign correction in r1 was the blind's own rule fed a decontaminated input
new_plays_proposed.falsifier: a program day whose residual tilt misleads while the gross aggregate reads true
